assumptions.description: Exact joint experimental treatment law q(T|W) is specified.
assumptions.machine_verifiability: Exact protocol syntax and probabilities checkable; real adherence not automatically verifiable.
assumptions.name: known_assignment_law
assumptions.scientific_scope: Randomized experiments D1-D6 only; legacy also records an admission.

assumptions.description: The full realized randomized allocation is conditionally independent of all potential outcomes.
assumptions.machine_verifiability: Protocol declaration/replay only; not a test of implementation fidelity.
assumptions.name: full_vector_randomization
assumptions.scientific_scope: R1a/R1b/R2, not an observational self-selection guarantee.

assumptions.description: Observed outcome equals the potential outcome under the actually realized intervention version.
assumptions.machine_verifiability: Cannot establish real-world intervention-version consistency from a typed claim.
assumptions.name: consistency

assumptions.description: Network and exposure reference sets are defined before the intervention.
assumptions.machine_verifiability: Typed topology/timing record checkable; exogeneity is a scientific claim.
assumptions.name: fixed_pretreatment_network
assumptions.scientific_scope: Current single-time, fixed, simple undirected network routes.

assumptions.description: Required conditional expectations exist and are finite.
assumptions.machine_verifiability: Declared integrability, not universally testable from finite samples.
assumptions.name: finite_conditional_first_moments

assumptions.description: For each covered node, E[Y_i(t)|W] is constant across full allocations with equal (t_i,g_i(t,W)).
assumptions.machine_verifiability: Typed licence and provenance checks; cannot prove the structural restriction empirically.
assumptions.name: mean_signature_sufficiency
assumptions.scientific_scope: R2 policy and R3-Signature policy only; signature/node/study bindings required.

assumptions.description: Given W, observational allocation is independent of the full potential-outcome vector.
assumptions.machine_verifiability: Requires explicit reviewed admission; observational data cannot by itself establish it.
assumptions.name: full_vector_conditional_exchangeability
assumptions.scientific_scope: R3-Full, R3-Signature and R3 p-standardized effects.

assumptions.description: Holding final complete T fixed, stage-one quota/profile U has no additional direct outcome effect.
assumptions.machine_verifiability: Dedicated explicit source/status gate; not implied by known D6 randomization.
assumptions.name: first_stage_profile_no_direct_outcome_effect
assumptions.scientific_scope: D6 randomized-design routes in addition to the ordinary R1/R2 conditions.

assumptions.description: Y_i(t) equals Y_i(t_i,g_i(t,G)) for all complete assignments, licensed nodes.
assumptions.machine_verifiability: Scoped admitted license checked; scientific truth not proven.
assumptions.name: potential_outcome_exposure_sufficiency
assumptions.scientific_scope: R3 exposure-adjustment subroute only; stronger than R2 mean sufficiency.

assumptions.description: Conditional mean ignorability of exposure potential outcomes given B,W.
assumptions.machine_verifiability: Scoped admitted license checked; observational data alone cannot prove it.
assumptions.name: exposure_level_conditional_exchangeability
assumptions.scientific_scope: R3 exposure-adjustment subroute only; not full-vector ignorability.

assumptions.description: E[Y_i(a,s)|Ti=a,Si=s,C_i,W]=E[Y_i(a,s)|C_i,W] where C_i=(X_i, neighbor positive X count).
assumptions.machine_verifiability: Scoped license checked; scientific truth not proven.
assumptions.name: local_covariate_exposure_mean_exchangeability
assumptions.scientific_scope: R3 v2.8 node-specific local covariate adjustment only.

caveat: NOT empirical business coverage; each case requires A4/A5/A6 checks; no observed business effects
